question: Amongst si× friends O, P, Q, R, S and T, each has a different height. P is taller than O. Q is taller than S but shorter than O. R is shorter than S but taller thanT. Who is the tallest among all the friends?
solution:
**Given: **Amongst si× friends O, P, Q, R, S and T, each has a different height.

1) P is taller than O.

2) Q is taller than S but shorter than O. 

P > O > Q > S

3) R is shorter than S but taller than T. 

P > O > Q > S > R > T

Thus, according to the final arrangement, P is the tallest among all the friends.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
